events.title: mFLUSIVA (mRNA-1010) — FDA PDUFA Decision
events.summary: FDA target action date for the seasonal influenza vaccine BLA in adults 50 and older, following a February 2026 refusal-to-file that was reversed after a Type A meeting.
events.result: Approved — the first mRNA-based seasonal flu vaccine licensed in the US. The 65+ indication was granted accelerated approval contingent on a postmarketing study spanning two flu seasons. Phase 3 showed 26.6% relative vaccine efficacy vs a standard-dose comparator.

events.title: Intismeran Autogene — Phase 3 INTerpath-001 (Melanoma)
events.summary: Pivotal adjuvant high-risk melanoma trial run with Merck in over 1,100 patients, testing the personalized mRNA cancer vaccine alongside KEYTRUDA.
events.result: Met primary and key secondary endpoints — the first positive Phase 3 readout for an mRNA cancer therapy. MRNA rose 177% intraday, then gave back roughly 8% the following session.
